#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MAXN = 10000010, BIG = 0x3f3f3f3f;
int n, m, k, c, d, src = 0, sink, total = 0;
int edge_cnt = 1, head[MAXN], to[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], cap[MAXN], cost[MAXN];
int dist[MAXN], flow[MAXN], prev_edge[MAXN]; bool in_queue[MAXN];

void add_edge(int x, int y, int z, int v) {
    to[++edge_cnt] = y; nxt[edge_cnt] = head[x]; head[x] = edge_cnt; cap[edge_cnt] = z; cost[edge_cnt] = v;
    to[++edge_cnt] = x; nxt[edge_cnt] = head[y]; head[y] = edge_cnt; cap[edge_cnt] = 0; cost[edge_cnt] = -v;
}

bool spfa() {
    fill(flow, flow + MAXN, 0);
    fill(dist, dist + MAXN, BIG);
    fill(in_queue, in_queue + MAXN, false);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(src); flow[src] = BIG; in_queue[src] = true; dist[src] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop(); in_queue[u] = false;
        for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
            if (!cap[i] || dist[to[i]] <= dist[u] + cost[i]) continue;
            dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + cost[i];
            flow[to[i]] = min(flow[u], cap[i]);
            prev_edge[to[i]] = i;
            if (!in_queue[to[i]]) {
                in_queue[to[i]] = true;
                q.push(to[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[sink] != BIG;
}

void augment() {
    int cur = sink;
    while (cur != src) {
        int e = prev_edge[cur];
        cap[e] -= flow[sink];
        cap[e ^ 1] += flow[sink];
        cur = to[e ^ 1];
    }
    total += flow[sink] * dist[sink];
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    sink = (n + k - 1) * n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> x;
        add_edge(src, x, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        cin >> x >> y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n + k; j++)
            for (int h = 1; h <= k; h++) {
                add_edge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + j * n, 1, d * h * 2 - d + c);
                add_edge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + j * n, 1, d * h * 2 - d + c);
            }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n + k; i++) {
        for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++)
            add_edge(j + (i - 1) * n, j + i * n, BIG, c);
        add_edge(1 + (i - 1) * n, 1 + i * n, BIG, 0);
    }
    while (spfa()) augment();
    cout << total << endl;
    return 0;
}
